Class SalableProduct

java.lang.Object
app.SalableProduct
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<SalableProduct>
Direct Known Subclasses:
Armor, Health, Weapon
public class SalableProduct extends Object implements Comparable<SalableProduct>
Represents an item sold at the Arena Supply Store. Common product information is stored here and inherited by all product types.

  • Constructor Details

    • SalableProduct

      public SalableProduct(String name, String description, double price, int quantity)
      Creates a product with the supplied information and available stock.
      Parameters:
      name - product name; cannot be blank
      description - product description; cannot be blank
      price - item price in dollars; must be finite and nonnegative
      quantity - starting inventory quantity; must be nonnegative
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a supplied value is not valid

    • compareTo

      public int compareTo(SalableProduct other)
      Compares two products by their names and prices. Names are compared alphabetically without considering case. If the names match, the products are compared by price.
      Specified by:
      compareTo in interface Comparable<SalableProduct>
      Parameters:
      other - the product being compared
      Returns:
      a negative number, zero, or a positive number depending on the comparison result
